svg.text: Clearing variable memory: the 6-cycle loop (cycles 12 to 49)
i_addr repeats 9c, a0, a4, a8, ac; every 6 cycles one write of 0 goes to d_addr (1b4174, 1b4178, ... +4 each time).
blue line = signal (high or low), box = bus value in hex, dashed = not shown (request is 0), green = clock; cycle 0 = reset release
